Text:
LATEST ZOMBIES ONLINE CHANGE-LOG

Read release notes at www.gunshine.net/forum

GENERAL FAQ
-----------

How do I save my game?
You don't need to save your game. Whenever you exit the game, or quit your browser, your progress is already saved on the server side. Next time you login and select your avatar, you will automatically continue in the area where you quit the game.

How do I buy more stuff for my character?
The quickest way to get new items for your character is to buy them from the shop. You can access the shop by pressing the shop item in the down right corner of the screen or pressing the shortcut S-key on your keyboard.

The second way to get items in Gunshine.net is to craft them.

What is crafting?
We made some big changes to the Crafting feature, and therefore the mobs and bosses don't drop weapons or gear anymore. All weapons and gear needs to be either crafted, or bought from the shop. To craft an item you need a certain \q\qPlan\q\q and then the required \q\qIngredients\q\q (some items require one type of ingredients, others up to five). Bosses drop Plans, Cash and Consumable Items, while the mobs drop Ingredients and Cash. You can also buy Plans and Ingredients from the shop if you haven't found what you are looking for and some Plans are given to you as you level up. In addition to this, you may even ask your friends to send you the required Ingredient you need! The following ingredients are available:

- Fabric
- Bolts
- Armor Plates
- Heavy Metal
- Power Cells
- Nano Bots

Ok, how do I craft a weapon or some gear then?
First press 'C' or click on Craft button at the bottom right corner to open the crafting window.

The crafting window lists all the plans you know. Each plan lists the ingredients and time needed to craft the item. If the 'Start' button is green, you have enough ingredients, and you can build the item by clicking on the 'Start' button.

If the 'Start' button is grey, you are missing some ingredients. You can buy the missing ingredients by pressing the green plus icon next to the ingredient, or get more by killing enemies.

When the item is ready, you must access the crafting window again to claim it. The 'Craft' button glows to show that there is an item ready to be claimed.

You can keep playing or log off while the item is being crafted.

The plans you know are divided into six categories (including skills!), so be sure to check all of them to find all the cool stuff you can build.

How do I equip my character?
Your bag can be opened by either pressing the \q\qb\q\q key, or by clicking on the bag icon down right.

When you move your mouse pointer over an item, it will show you both the information of the item, and the item you are currently using. If the new unused item has better values (stronger armor, better damage etc.), simply double-click the icon and your character will be equipped with it. Various types of items have their own slots, so you can't drop them in all the slots.

My bag is full. What should I do?
If your bag is full, you can expand it by clicking the Add Slots button in the bag.

In addition, you can also either sell your items by dragging them to the Drag An Item Here To Sell it -slot in the down right corner of the bag. If you choose to destroy any of your items, simply click and hold on your item, and drag it onto the game area and drop it. The game will verify if you want to destroy it or not.

What are \q\qMeeting Area\q\q levels?
The Meeting Area levels are marked with a special glow effect. No battles, no looting and no fuzz, in other words most of these levels contain no enemies, only friendly NPC's and other players. You may get missions in the Meeting Area levels though, so don't just walk past them. Meeting areas have PvP (Player versus Player) arenas where you can fight against other players.

What are Diamonds and how can I buy them?
Diamonds have more value than the in-game money (dollars), and can be used as a payment method for items. You can purchase Diamonds with real money by clicking on the Diamond icon and then choose your payment method.

What are skills? How do I use them? How can I get more?
You may want to increase your skills during your game, and you can do so by entering the crafting menu. Press crafting icon or the key \q\qC\q\q on your keyboard, open the skills tab and press start to learn a new skill. After the crafting is done, your new skill will appear on the skill bar ready for use.

What are the different shortcuts available?
The shortcuts in Gunshine.net are:

* Space key - toggles melee/ranged weapon
* Enter key - Chat
* a - achievements
* b or i - opens up your inventory & character view
* c - crafting window
* f - opens up your friends list
* m - opens up the world map
* p - inbox
* s - opens up the shop
* 1-0 - uses the item shown in the item bar
* Q-Y - uses your skills

What is a group? How do I set up a group?
A group is also known as a \q\qparty\q\q in some other similar kind of games. You can invite friends to join your group, or your friends can invite you into a group. You will notice that the group leader has a small crown-icon next to his/her name.

Simply click on the group icon down to the right, or press the f-key, click on your friends' name and invite him/her to your group. If your friend accepts to join the group, he/she will be transferred close to your location. It's that simple.

What is the Boss Finder?
The Boss Finder is a cool new feature that we added in order to make group formation as easy as possible. Simply click on the boss finder, choose the boss you want challenge, and the tool will automatically find you a group and move to the right area on the world map.

A group is formed once the following setup has been found: Two hunters, a doctor and a bodyguard.

How can I change my character or create a new one?
To change your character / create a new one press the settings button in the right upper corner of the game screen. From there select change character and you will be able to change your character or create a new one entirely.

How can I delete a character?
At the moment it is not possible to delete characters in Gunshine.net.

I have some quests available in prison area, but cant access them. Why?
That particular quest is a part of the new tutorial, and it's unfortunately not accessible for those players who have completed the tutorial in a previous version of the game. In order to complete the new tutorial you need to create a new character entirely.

How do I become a mod?
Be supportive and respectful at all times, help players in need (primarily with information) and read and write on the forums regularly. However, this doesn't automatically mean that you will be selected as a mod. Supercell & Gunshine.net mods & admins are the persons who will choose the new mods.

What is a mod anyway?
A mod is a short name of moderator. A mod is a player who have done all that mentioned above and has proven his or her value to the community. A moderator upholds the order both in the game and on our forums. If a user misbehaves (uses swearwords, writes with CAPS ON, is disrespectful towards other community members etc.) a mod can put that user on a Global Ignore, or even Global Block. In the game mods text is green.

What is a Global Ignore and Global Block?
Global Ignore means that the user can not chat to anyone. Global Block means that the user can not chat, can't invite into groups or join groups. Usually Global Blocks & Ignores are lifted within 24h, but in some rare cases the user can be blocked for a longer time.

What is an admin then?
Admins are Supercell employees and you can't become one unless you work for the company. They are able to apply changes to the game directly, and ban a user from the game completely. In the game admins text is red.


CHAT FAQ
--------

What are the in-game chat rules?
In the in-game chat you need to follow the rules set by either an admin, or a moderator. If the admin or moderator tells you to stop doing something, it is by default a rule which you need to comply with. If not, you can get globally ignored, globally blocked or in the worst case banned.

Rules are:

- No profanity
- No racist comments
- No hate speech
- No spam
- No CAPS


MOD & ADMIN FAQ
---------------

How to become a Moderator FAQ
Q: What is a mod?
A: mod is short for moderator. We are players that got promoted to pretty much being \q\qchat police\q\q.

Q: What does a mod do?
A: Moderators help out other players with pretty much everything needed. If you have a question don't hesitate to ask us. However we usually will not group up with players unless we say we will. Also we regulate chat by calming players down.
Note that it may take us some time to respond. So be patient.

Q: Can mods ban players?
A: Yes and no. We can mute players from chat and report issues to admins who would then really call a ban.

Q: When do mods or even admins mute/ban players?
A: When we feel that it is necessary. If a player breaks the (chat) rules and doesnt listen to what we advise them to do we take action. If this happens again and again we will talk about banning players.
Those that try to cheat or hack get banned asap.

Q: How can I become a mod?
A: Be supportive at all times, respect the rules set and best be on the forums too to be informed.
Then if there is an official announcement by Bouncer that new mods are needed, apply. Having a good reputation among players helps too.

Q: Do mods get special perks?
A: No we don't. We do not get special gear and we do not auto-level to 30 or beyond. Everything we have we played for.

Q: What is the difference between mod and admin?
A: Moderators are players that have proven themselves worthy of the position they are in. Admins are actual game developers from Supercell.
In chat mods writing is in green while the admins is in red.

Q: Do moderators and admins have a line of thumb?
A: Yes. Better behave.
End of help
